body:
James K: Hey team — Support request: Tom (contractor) needs temporary Intercom access to triage customer chats for the next 2 weeks. Can security confirm minimal scope and any redaction we should enforce?
Mira S (sec): Thanks for flagging. Two quick Qs: 1) does Tom need message export/download? 2) will he handle any tickets with PII (credit card, SSNs)?
James K: No exports, just live chat view and assign. We'll block any channels flagged for billing/finance. He shouldn't see payment details.
Laura G: From CS side: we can create a custom role in Intercom that only gives "conversations:read, reply" and no export. We can also enable masked view for custom attributes.
Mira S (sec): Sounds good. Please ensure SSO + SCIM provision via Okta and set session timeout to 30m. Also enable IP allowlist for the contractor's IP.
okta-bot: Provision request created: ticket OKTA-8812. Pending approval from sec and IT.
Tom C (contractor): I only need access from 9–5 PT and will be on VPN. No exports required.
Mira S (sec): Ok — checklist from sec: 1) least-priv role (no exports) 2) SSO only (no shared creds) 3) IP allowlist + company VPN 4) session timeout 30m 5) no access to billing/segments containing payment info 6) DPA signed if not already.
Ethan L (legal): We have a DPA for Intercom on file. I'll confirm contractor addendum coverage — if Tom is a contractor to a partner, we may need a subprocessor notice. I'll update here in ~2h.
James K: For logging redaction, do we need to mask user messages in our app logs before they hit Intercom? We currently forward chat transcripts via webhook for analytics.
Mira S (sec): Yes — redact before forwarding. Minimal regex we require in the webhook pipeline: ``/\b(?:ssn|social_security_number|creditcard|cc_number|card_number)\b[:=]?\s*\S+/gi`` — replace matches with `[REDACTED]`. Also strip any 16-digit sequences and email domains if flagged.
Laura G: We can add a middleware to the webhook that filters those fields. I'll drop a small snippet in the ticket.
Laura G: Snippet: ```js
// simple redact
payload.message = payload.message.replace(/(\b\d{16}\b)/g, '[REDACTED]')
payload.message = payload.message.replace(/(ssn|creditcard|card_number)[:=]?\s*\S+/gi, '[REDACTED]')
```
Mira S (sec): Add a logging rule to avoid storing the raw payload: set logger to `payload_safe` and truncate >1000 chars. Also audit logs for that Intercom service should be routed to our SIEM.
James K: Great — sounds like a plan. @Ethan L please confirm DPA/subprocessor and @Mira S can sign off when Okta ticket shows provisioned and allowlist is set.
Ethan L (legal): Confirmed DPA covers Intercom; if contractor is via partner org we'll need subprocessor notice — will have it by EOD.
okta-bot: OKTA-8812 status: Approved by Mira S (sec). Account provision scheduled.
Mira S (sec): Approved. Tom's access should be role-limited and expire in 14 days. Post-access review scheduled for 2026-03-10.
Tom C (contractor): Thanks — I'll wait for the invite and will use VPN.
James K: Closing loop here once Tom confirms access works. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
